purpose: Teach: 勝敗/最下位/制し/打者/飛ばさ/下級/背負う/威厳

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、勝敗のメンタル研究、興味深いですね。
lines.en: Your paper on mental resilience in competitive sports — the psychology of winning and losing — that's really compelling work.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely interested. Leans forward slightly. Open cadence — inviting him to continue. Clear-eyed, not performing engagement.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。最下位チームの心理、特に章を割きました。
lines.en: Yes. I focused an entire chapter on the psychology of teams at the bottom of the standings — how they cope.
lines.style: Careful, precise. Slight hesitation before 'bottom' — wants to get the framing right. Measured pace. Modest but not self-effacing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 逆境を制した選手の事例、印象的でしたね。
lines.en: The case studies of athletes who overcame adversity — those stayed with me. Really striking examples.
lines.style: Genuine warmth. A small nod in the voice. Slower pace on 'stayed with me' — emphasizing the impact. Meeting his eyes.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 打者のフォーム分析、新しい視点で扱いました。
lines.en: I analyzed batter form and mechanics from a fresh angle — looking for patterns that hadn't been examined before.
lines.style: Gaining confidence mid-sentence. Slight lift on 'fresh angle' — a quiet pride. Steady, not rushed. The voice of someone learning to believe in his own insight.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ホームランを飛ばさない練習、データで示しましたね。
lines.en: The section on minimal-preparation practice — you backed that up with solid data. That was smart.
lines.style: Affirmative nod in the tone. Direct but warm. Short, clean sentences. Recognition without overdoing it. Teacher-to-student respect.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 下級リーグの研究、限定的な先行研究、引用しました。
lines.en: There's not much prior research on lower leagues, so I was careful to cite what does exist and be transparent about the limitations.
lines.style: Careful, methodical. Slight emphasis on 'transparent' — shows intellectual honesty matters to him. No apology in the tone, just precision. Steady breathing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 責任を背負う立場の心情、共感を呼びますね。
lines.en: What really comes through is the emotional weight of being in charge — the pressure coaches carry. That resonates with people.
lines.style: Thoughtful, reflective. Pause before 'that resonates' — noticing something true about the work. Gentle emphasis. The voice of someone who sees what he's written matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 監督の威厳、競技ごとに、違いますね。
lines.en: That's interesting — the authority coaches hold, the dignity of the role, it really does vary from sport to sport, doesn't it.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity — not closing the thought but opening it. Slight rise at the end, collaborative. Leaning into the idea together. Warm, not correcting.
